title: IP Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP)
summary: Describes an updated version of the Encapsulating Security Payload, which provides a mix of security services in IPv4 and IPv6. These include confidentiality, data origin authentication, connectionless integrity, anti-replay protection, and limited traffic flow confidentiality. It replaces RFC 2406 and is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: A sealed, opaque envelope around your data. Nobody can read it or swap its contents, and old copies are spotted if someone tries to resend them.
